description: Break and collect block(s) (or pick up an item-drop entity) using the collectblock plugin. `target` is a block name (collects the N nearest, see `count`), a {x,y,z} block position, or a numeric entity id (item drop). When the inventory fills, items are deposited into `chestLocations`; use `depositItems`/`keepItems` to control what gets stored. Long-running and cancellable.

append.description: Append to the existing collection task instead of starting fresh

chestLocations.description: Chest positions to deposit into when the inventory fills

count.description: When target is a block name, how many nearest blocks to collect (default 1)

depositItems.description: Only these item names are moved to a chest (mutually exclusive with keepItems)

ignoreNoPath.description: Do not error if no path to a target can be found; pick the best reachable spot

keepItems.description: Keep these item names; everything else may be deposited

target.description: Block name (e.g. "oak_log"), a {x,y,z} block position, or a numeric item-drop entity id

name: collect_block
